stories.title: 比特幣白皮書發表滿 18 年
stories.title_en: 18 Years Since Satoshi's Bitcoin Whitepaper Debut
stories.summary: 2008-10-31 Satoshi 發出九頁白皮書；今日 BTC 約 $77k、市值約 $1.55T，社群紀念去中心化現金構想。
stories.summary_en: On October 31, 2008, Satoshi Nakamoto sent the Bitcoin whitepaper. Today Bitcoin trades near $77,000 with a $1.55 trillion market cap.
stories.why_it_matters: 周年情緒＋價位錨點影響週末廣度；弱市亦常見敘事回流。

stories.title: 多個加密項目網站遭 DNS 劫持釣魚
stories.title_en: DNS Hijacking Hits Multiple Crypto Project Websites
stories.summary: Flap、Kintsu 等站被導向 Step Drainer 惡意頁；Blockaid 點名約 12 個站，呼籲唔好連錢包／簽名。
stories.summary_en: Flap's website flap.sh and others like Kintsu fell victim to DNS hijacking, redirecting visitors to malicious pages linked to the Step Drainer toolkit. Blockaid flagged 12 sites total.
stories.why_it_matters: 釣魚／DNS 劫持會即時偷錢包；模擬倉以外亦提醒核對官方頻道先連錢包。

stories.title: Chainalysis 遭入侵：客戶姓名電郵外洩
stories.title_en: Chainalysis Breach Exposes Customer Names and Emails in Cyberattack
stories.summary: Chainalysis 稱外部攻擊者取得用戶 ID、全名、電郵同組織角色；強調無關 Binance 盜竊、無密碼／調查數據外洩。
stories.summary_en: Chainalysis said an intruder accessed user IDs, names, emails, and roles; no investigation data or passwords.
stories.why_it_matters: 合規數據商亦中招→釣魚風險上升；留意冒充 Chainalysis 嘅郵件。

stories.title: Trezor 警告 Safe 5 遭植入竊聽板
stories.title_en: Trezor Warns of Tampered Hardware Wallets from CryptoBilis
stories.summary: 印尼買家發現 CryptoBilis 渠道 Safe 5 藏蜂窩植入板；Trezor 籲 2026-03 起該經銷商買家立刻搬倉換新助記詞。
stories.summary_en: Trezor urges customers who bought any model from former reseller CryptoBilis since March 2026 to immediately move funds to new wallets with fresh recovery seeds after a Safe 5 implant report.
stories.why_it_matters: 硬體供應鏈攻擊直接偷 seed；自託管要用官方渠道＋自檢。

stories.title: Satoshi 相關地址仍持約 $850 億 BTC 未動
stories.title_en: Satoshi's $85 Billion Bitcoin Sits Untouched Amid Binance Hack Fears
stories.summary: Arkham 顯示約 109.6 萬 BTC 散落逾 2.1 萬地址、十五年以上未動；對比交易所熱錢包頻遭攻擊。
stories.summary_en: Arkham data shows about 1.096 million BTC across Satoshi-linked addresses still unmoved.
stories.why_it_matters: 對照 Binance 熱錢包風險：冷儲／多簽敘事再被放大。

stories.title: Ansem 開 $88 萬 SOL 空單、$ANSEM 幣急挫
stories.title_en: Ansem Shorts $880K SOL Amid $ANSEM Meme Coin Plunge
stories.summary: Pumpfun perps 上 Ansem 放空約 $880k SOL；其同名幣自高位跌逾 87%，社群爭議空投同營收。
stories.summary_en: Ansem placed a $880,610 short on SOL with a $101.64 liquidation price. His $ANSEM coin dropped over 87% from peak.
stories.why_it_matters: KOL 倉位同同名幣脫鈎→跟風模擬倉要分開睇訊號同敘事。

stories.title: 交易員 Frank 平掉逾千萬美元迷因幣空單
stories.title_en: Crypto Trader Frank Closes Million-Dollar Memecoin Shorts
stories.summary: 平倉 BTC／ZEC／NEAR／PUMP 等約 $1230 萬槓桿空單；迷因總市值由高峰 $1500 億跌至約 $300 億。
stories.summary_en: Frank, a seasoned crypto trader, shuttered his $12.3 million leveraged short positions on Bitcoin, ZEC, NEAR, and PUMP after booking profits amid a memecoin cooldown. He reflected on the mental strain, noting how holding through drawdowns often earns the 'cancer holder' label, wh
stories.why_it_matters: 大戶平倉＝短線動能轉冷訊號，弱市半倉規則仍然啱用。

stories.title: Strategy（MSTR）改以優先股為主囤幣
stories.title_en: Strategy Details Preferred Stock Shift for Bitcoin Buys Amid Earnings Volatility
stories.summary: Q3：持倉 848,517 BTC 均價 ~$75,446；往後主要以 STRC 等數位信貸融資買 BTC，普通股銷售受限。
stories.summary_en: In its third-quarter earnings call, CEO Phong Le announced that Strategy (MSTR) will mainly issue digital credit like its STRC preferred stock to fund Bitcoin purchases, reserving common stock sales for dividends and interest only above 1x modified net asset value. The company re
stories.why_it_matters: 機構買盤結構變→BTC 波動同股票聯動要重新估。

stories.title: Aave 解凍借貸市場（Binance 事件後）
stories.title_en: Aave Reopens Lending Markets After Binance Breach Freeze
stories.summary: 盜賊將 $6000 萬 USDT 打入 Aave V3 借 $4460 萬 WETH；Aave 曾凍結 16 鏈 292 儲備，其後分階段重開。
stories.summary_en: On October 29, attackers stole funds from Binance and funneled $60 million in USDT to Aave V3 Ethereum, borrowing $44.6 million in WETH before Aave froze 292 reserves across 16 networks as a precaution. Markets reopened in stages.
stories.why_it_matters: CEX→DeFi 傳導風險；穩定幣同借貸協議流動性仍敏感。

stories.title: 香港持牌 HKDAP 穩定幣登陸 Solana
stories.title_en: Anchorpoint Brings HKD Stablecoin HKDAP to Solana Blockchain
stories.summary: Anchorpoint（渣打香港／HKT／Animoca）首次把 HKDAP 鑄造／贖回擴到 Solana，基金會成策略夥伴。
stories.summary_en: HK-licensed Anchorpoint partners with Solana to mint/redeem HKDAP on Solana.
stories.why_it_matters: 非美元穩定幣上 SOL→亞洲支付同 RWA 流動性敘事。

stories.title: Polymarket 第三方腳本被入侵：暫停交易
stories.title_en: Polymarket Halts Trading After Third-Party Hack Drains $2.7 Million
stories.summary: DebugBear 監控腳本被注入，約 $270 萬被轉走；平台退款並另補約 $119 萬交易損失。
stories.summary_en: Attackers exploited a DebugBear monitoring script, draining about $2.7 million; Polymarket refunded users.
stories.why_it_matters: 前端第三方 JS 風險＝連接錢包前要核域名／擴充功能。

stories.title: 神秘巨鯨五日拋售約 $1.04 億 SOL
stories.title_en: Mysterious Whale Dumps $104 Million in Solana Tokens
stories.summary: 逾 102 萬枚 SOL 流入 Gate／Kraken；SOL 測試 $100 附近支撐，同時 RWA 創新高。
stories.summary_en: Whale sold over 1.02M SOL (~$104.3M) over five days into Gate.io and Kraken.
stories.why_it_matters: 供應壓力對 SOL 生態幣急升捕捉窗口不利。

stories.title: Solana RWA 破 $50 億並接 Polygon 支付棧
stories.title_en: Solana RWA Value Tops $5 Billion with Polygon Integration
stories.summary: RWA 約 $51.9 億；Polygon Open Money Stack 接入 Solana，方便企業跨鏈穩定幣出入金。
stories.summary_en: Solana RWA hit $5.19B; Polygon integrated Solana into Open Money Stack.
stories.why_it_matters: 機構敘事強≠迷因急升；分清 RWA 流量同投機熱。

stories.title: 開發者 reverse-engineer Pump.fun 收律師信
stories.title_en: Solana Developer Faces Cease-and-Desist for Reverse-Engineering Pump.fun Contracts
stories.summary: Shaw 公開合約字節碼分析後收 Bracket C&D；社群爭論閉源合約安全風險。
stories.summary_en: Bracket Company sent a C&D to developer Shaw for reverse-engineering Pump.fun contracts; he argues bytecode is public.
stories.why_it_matters: 龍頭發射台透明度爭議→跟風盤風險溢價。

stories.title: 新加坡警籲留意零售渠道改裝 Ledger
stories.title_en: Singapore Police Warn of Tampered Ledger Wallets in Retail Stores
stories.summary: 至少兩宗改裝硬體盜 seed，損失約 $270 萬；Ledger 指少數東南亞經銷商。
stories.summary_en: Since September 10, at least two victims fell prey to tampered Ledger wallets sold at some Singapore retail outlets, with about $2.7 million lost.
stories.why_it_matters: 同 Trezor 植入同一類供應鏈攻擊；硬體只買官方。

stories.title: 摩斯密碼誘騙 AI 錢包代理轉走十多萬美元
stories.title_en: Morse Code Trick Drains $150K from AI Wallet Agent
stories.summary: 攻擊者在 X 藏指令，經 Grok 解碼後令 Base 上 Bankrbot 轉走約 $15–20 萬代幣。
stories.summary_en: An attacker hid a command in Morse code on X, fooling Grok into translating it to Bankrbot which sent $150K–$200K in tokens.
stories.why_it_matters: AI agent 控錢包＝提示注入即係盜竊；自動化交易要人為閘。

stories.title: 代幣化股票市值達 $46.3 億
stories.title_en: Tokenized Stocks Hit $4.63 Billion Milestone Echoing Early Stablecoins
stories.summary: 由年初不足 $10 億急升；Binance bStocks／Ondo／xStocks 佔約 81%，BNB Chain 領先。
stories.summary_en: The sector has surged from under $1 billion at the start of the year, led by issuers like Binance’s bStocks, Ondo, and xStocks, which control 81 percent of the market.
stories.why_it_matters: RWA／代幣化股票敘事分流資金，迷因板要分清題材。

stories.title: 比特幣主導率回落至約 60%，山寨有輪動跡象
stories.title_en: Bitcoin Dominance Dips as Altcoins Show Signs of Surge
stories.summary: BTC.D ~60.1%，有交易員指資金轉向山寨；altseason 指數仍中性。
stories.summary_en: Bitcoin dominance has dropped to around 60.1%, while altcoin dominance climbs sharply, prompting talk of money rotating from Bitcoin to smaller coins.
stories.why_it_matters: 主導率下跌係廣度轉好前置訊號，但仍要睇弱市半倉閘。

stories.title: Coinbase 上架 Ripple RLUSD 穩定幣
stories.title_en: Coinbase Lists Ripple's RLUSD Stablecoin for U.S. Users
stories.summary: 零售／交易所／Prime 均可兌換；RLUSD 市值約 $26 億，近 90 日淨流入逾 $10 億。
stories.summary_en: Coinbase added RLUSD to its retail app, exchange, and Prime platform on October 28, enabling 1:1 conversions from dollars or other stablecoins across XRP Ledger, Ethereum, and Base networks. The stablecoin now boasts a $2.6 billion market cap.
stories.why_it_matters: 穩定幣競爭加劇→交易對同資金費環境變化。

stories.title: SPX6900 靠社區死撐，市值仍約數億美元
stories.title_en: SPX6900 Memecoin Thrives on Relentless Community Positivity
stories.summary: 無團隊無路線圖，口號「stop trading and believe」；有人連續數百日定投，近有逾 $90 萬現貨買盤。
stories.summary_en: SPX6900 launched on Ethereum in August 2023 as a satirical memecoin aiming to outgrow the S&P 500, with no team or roadmap—just community conviction. Price sits around $0.36.
stories.why_it_matters: 文化幣波動同跟風熱度會污染急升板噪音。

stories.title: Shopify 商戶經 Coinbase 協議結算 $4200 萬 USDC
stories.title_en: Shopify Merchants Settle $42 Million in USDC Payments via Coinbase Protocol
stories.summary: Base 上 Commerce Payments Protocol 已處理約 44.8 萬筆支付，商戶可定時兌法幣。
stories.summary_en: Shopify and Coinbase built an open-source Commerce Payments Protocol on Base, with over $42 million already settled across 448,000 payments.
stories.why_it_matters: 穩定幣消費落地＝鏈上流動性結構長期利好敘事。

stories.title: CFTC 主席想像雪櫃代你買賣加密貨幣
stories.title_en: CFTC Chair Envisions Fridge Trading Crypto for Groceries
stories.summary: Selig 在 Frontier Forum 談 AI agent 自主持倉／發射迷因幣，提出 know-your-agent 監管問題。
stories.summary_en: At the CFTC's first Frontier Forum on October 28 in Washington, D.C., Selig described autonomous AI agents that could hold assets, trade crypto, and even launch memecoins without human oversight. He raised key questions like who registers these agents, who's liable if they go rog
stories.why_it_matters: 監管框架若落實會影響自動化交易同迷因發射合規成本。

stories.title: PEPE 對 BTC 兩年跌勢疑似打破，巨鯨吸貨
stories.title_en: PEPE Meme Coin Breaks Two-Year Downtrend Amid Whale Buys
stories.summary: PEPE 約 $0.00000493、市值 ~$20.7 億、24h 成交逾 $8 億；有地址提走約 $5100 萬。
stories.summary_en: PEPE trades near $0.00000493 with a $2.07 billion market cap and over $800 million in 24-hour volume, signaling strong interest despite mixed broader markets. On-chain data shows wallets tied to Justin Sun withdrawing $51 million worth, boosting accumulation by smart money. Analy
stories.why_it_matters: 老牌迷因若轉勢會帶動急升板噪音，要對照成交同廣度。

stories.title: 網民玩梗叫 Binance 駭客下一步打 Pump.fun
stories.title_en: Crypto Users Urge Binance Hackers to Target Pump.fun
stories.summary: Binance 熱錢包被盜後 SAFU 包底、穩定幣方凍結約 $30 億；社群以梗圖指向 Pump.fun。
stories.summary_en: The October 29 breach hit hot wallets across nine blockchains, but Binance assured users their funds are safe, covering losses through its SAFU fund while stablecoin issuers froze $3 billion in stolen assets. Posts flooded in joking about directing suspected Lazarus Group hackers
stories.why_it_matters: 情緒宣洩多過實質威脅，但反映發射台信任裂縫。

stories.title: Murad：AGI 時代迷因幣或比工具幣更耐玩
stories.title_en: Memecoins Seen Outlasting Utility Tokens in AGI Era
stories.summary: 指社群／文化唔可被代碼自動化取代，SPX6900 等聚會作例；亦有人警告發射門檻下降。
stories.summary_en: Murad, a prominent memecoin advocate, argued that community-driven memecoins will outperform utility and revenue-focused projects once artificial general intelligence automates code-based models. He and others emphasize that AGI cannot replicate the culture, belief, and real-worl
stories.why_it_matters: 敘事戰影響資金偏好，唔等於短線捕捉率。

stories.title: Pump.fun 吸費逾 $23 億，賺到錢戶口極少
stories.title_en: Pump.fun Traders Lose Billions as Platform Profits Soar
stories.summary: 分析指平台留約 $13.7 億費；僅 0.4% 帳戶鎖利超 $1 萬，#BOYCOTTPUMPFUN 再起。
stories.summary_en: Analysis: $2.34B fees into Pump.fun; only 0.4% of accounts locked >$10k profits; platform kept $1.37B.
stories.why_it_matters: 發射台期望值極負→紙上倉跟風要極嚴閘。

stories.title: Pump.fun 接入 Hyperliquid 永續合約
stories.title_en: Pump.fun Launches Perpetual Futures Trading with Hyperliquid Integration
stories.summary: 整合逾 300 個市場、最高約 50x，可用 USDC／SOL；另成 Elysium L2 獨家交易夥伴。
stories.summary_en: Pump.fun integrated over 300 Hyperliquid markets with up to 50x leverage.
stories.why_it_matters: 迷因前端＋高槓桿 perps＝波動同清算風險同時放大。

stories.title: $LAUNCH 疑似 rug：一小時跌逾九成
stories.title_en: $LAUNCH Token Crashes in Alleged Rug Pull
stories.summary: 自稱改善 Pump.fun 機制，市值一度 $400 萬後崩至不足 $25 萬；兩錢包提前套現。
stories.summary_en: $LAUNCH crashed over 90% in an hour after hitting ~$4M mcap; community called rug.
stories.why_it_matters: 新盤敘事＝高 rug 率；急升板要避開無流動性新發射。

stories.title: GTA VI 迷因幣急升後崩盤，錢包群被質疑
stories.title_en: GTA VI Memecoin Surges Then Crashes Amid Wallet Cluster Suspicions
stories.summary: $GTA6 市值近 $1800 萬後單錢包兩分鐘出貨 $14.6 萬致跌 64%；六個頭寸錢包同日創建。
stories.summary_en: $GTA6 on Solana climbed then dumped 64% after a wallet sold $146k in under two minutes; cluster wallets flagged.
stories.why_it_matters: 題材幣典型出貨模式；捕捉率統計勿計入呢類噪音。

stories.title: 少年騙局盜 $1300 萬 BTC 判囚 25 個月
stories.title_en: Teen Scammer Gets 25 Months for $13 Million Bitcoin Heist
stories.summary: Trenton Johnston 扮 Google／Trezor 客服社交工程得手；退還約 $380 萬後判刑並將遣返。
stories.summary_en: Trenton Johnston pleaded guilty to conspiring in a social engineering plot that stole about $13 million in Bitcoin, sentenced to 25 months.
stories.why_it_matters: 假客服仍係主流盜幣路徑；永遠唔好讀出 seed。

stories.title: Keystone 破口後將銷毀近 1.9 萬部未售機
stories.title_en: Keystone Hardware Wallet to Destroy 18,835 Devices After Breach
stories.summary: Shopify 第三方工具洩 WebAuth key，可令假機通過官方驗證；庫存 18,835 部銷毀。
stories.summary_en: After a Shopify breach exposed a WebAuth key, Keystone will destroy 18,835 in-stock devices.
stories.why_it_matters: 硬體驗證鏈被攻破＝買機要改用新金鑰批次。

stories.title: Starknet 基金會凍結 Binance 案中 $19 被盜金
stories.title_en: Starknet Foundation Freezes $19 of Stolen Funds in Binance Heist Response
stories.summary: 快速鎖 428 枚 STRK（約 $19）引社群迷因式鼓掌；對比 Tether／Circle 凍結約 $30 億。
stories.summary_en: Starknet Foundation locked 428 $STRK (~$19) from Binance heist-linked funds.
stories.why_it_matters: 跨鏈凍結能力參差→橋接同小幣風險不對稱。

stories.title: 2FactorFinance 推長期槓桿敞口 Beta（Base）
stories.title_en: 2FactorFinance Launches Beta for Long-Term Leveraged Exposure on Base
stories.summary: 分優先／次級份額，用 Kelly 準則做數月級槓桿，避開日衰減；目標 BTC ~1.33x。
stories.summary_en: 2FactorFinance's public beta on Base splits assets like cbBTC into senior tranches for protected yield and junior ones for leveraged upside, powered by Kelly criterion for multi-month holds. It avoids borrowing pitfalls and daily decay by tapping stable yield pools, targeting 1.3
stories.why_it_matters: 結構化槓桿產品或影響紙上倉風險分層討論。

stories.title: Beepzfun 發射台在 Robinhood Chain 受關注
stories.title_en: Beepzfun Launchpad Draws Attention on Robinhood Chain
stories.summary: 固定價銘文買賣、合約託管原子成交；已有逾 100 銘文，強調社區多過曝光。
stories.summary_en: The platform on Robinhood Chain lets sellers set prices, locking assets in smart contracts for atomic buys that transfer ownership and payment together, minus fees. Admin powers include pausing or upgrading but not touching balances directly, with plans to renounce ownership late
stories.why_it_matters: 新鏈發射台敘事多，流動性同 rug 風險仍高。

stories.title: Ansem 發片：維持看淡 BTC／ETH／大盤
stories.title_en: Ansem Shares Bearish Crypto Trading Breakdown Video
stories.summary: 指 FOMC 無驚喜，分享 ETH 空單思路；當時 BTC~$81k、ETH~$2360、SOL~$102。
stories.summary_en: He called the recent FOMC meeting a nothing burger, outlined a Monday high/low playbook, and shared an Ethereum short amid Bitcoin near $81,000, Ethereum at $2,360, and Solana around $102. Ansem sticks to his bearish stance on Bitcoin, Ethereum, and large-cap stocks, predicting m
stories.why_it_matters: KOL 偏向影響週末情緒，但唔取代廣度數據。

stories.title: 假 Trust Wallet 卡網站盜用戶資金
stories.title_en: Fake Trust Wallet Card Sites Drain User Funds
stories.summary: 冒牌站承諾無 KYC 金屬卡／高回贈，誘使連錢包授權轉走 USDT。
stories.summary_en: Scammers created phony Trust Wallet-branded sites promising no-KYC cards that trick users into connecting wallets for theft.
stories.why_it_matters: 品牌釣魚常見；只經官方 App／域名操作。
